name: Grand Prix points scale
gameplay_effect: Sets how many points each classified place pays, before fastest-lap, sprint, shortened-race or double-points modifiers.

name: Point for fastest lap
gameplay_effect: Adds a bonus championship point for the fastest race lap when the era pays one.

name: Points for a shared car
gameplay_effect: Decides whether two drivers who share one car split that car's points.

name: Which results count toward the title
gameplay_effect: Drops a driver's worst finishes when the championship only counts a best-N or a split-season quota.

name: Double points at the final round
gameplay_effect: Doubles the points paid by the last round of the season.

name: Points when a race is stopped short
gameplay_effect: Scales championship points when the leader has not completed the scheduled distance.

name: How constructor points are counted
gameplay_effect: Controls whether a constructor scores with every car or only its best finisher, or whether that title exists.

name: Indianapolis 500 in the World Championship
gameplay_effect: Includes or excludes the Indianapolis 500 from the drivers' championship.

name: Qualifying format
gameplay_effect: Sets how the Grand Prix grid is decided and how much fuel or tyre strategy leaks into qualifying.

name: Sprint weekend format
gameplay_effect: Adds a short points race on selected weekends and decides whether it sets the Grand Prix grid.

name: Team orders
gameplay_effect: Allows or forbids a team instructing one of its drivers to surrender a position.

name: Parc fermé before the race
gameplay_effect: Freezes setup after a session, so overnight changes and qualifying fuel strategy stop being free.

name: Safety car
gameplay_effect: Neutralises the race with a physical safety car, and from 2015 also a virtual safety car that keeps gaps.

name: Drag reduction system
gameplay_effect: Lets a following car open the rear wing on designated straights to make a pass.

name: Moveable aerodynamic devices
gameplay_effect: Controls whether wings may move, which changes straight-line speed versus corner downforce.

name: Track testing during the season
gameplay_effect: Limits how many private laps a team can run between races, which slows development and setup learning.

name: Wind tunnel and CFD limits
gameplay_effect: Caps aerodynamic research, and from 2021 gives lower-ranked teams more tunnel and CFD time.

name: Team cost cap base
gameplay_effect: Caps team spending for a 21-race season before indexation, which stops a rich team buying unlimited development.

name: Power-unit manufacturer cost cap base
gameplay_effect: Caps what an engine maker may spend, which matters once the player becomes a supplier.

name: Cars a team may enter
gameplay_effect: Sets whether a team can enter one car or must field a pair, which changes budget and points.

name: Customer chassis
gameplay_effect: Decides if a team may buy a rival's chassis or must design its own car to be a constructor.

name: Refuelling during the race
gameplay_effect: Allows or bans adding fuel in a pit stop, which switches races between fuel stops and one-stop tyre races.

name: Fuel chemistry
gameplay_effect: Restricts how exotic the fuel blend may be, which changes power, cost and supplier deals.

name: Fuel allowed for the race
gameplay_effect: Caps how much fuel a car may use in the race, which forces lift-and-coast or shorter fuel loads.

name: Engine capacity and layout
gameplay_effect: Sets displacement, cylinder layout and whether a turbo or supercharger is part of the formula.

name: Turbo or supercharging
gameplay_effect: Allows, bans or requires forced induction, which swings power against fuel use and reliability.

name: Hybrid energy recovery
gameplay_effect: Adds a deployable electric boost and, in the hybrid era, an energy-management strategy every lap.

name: Engines or power units per driver
gameplay_effect: Limits how many engines a driver may use and applies grid penalties when the pool is exceeded.

name: Minimum car weight
gameplay_effect: Sets the lightest legal car, so ballast placement and excess weight change lap time.

name: Separate driver-and-seat mass allowance
gameplay_effect: Adds ballast up to a reference driver mass so a lighter driver is not a weight advantage.

name: Major aerodynamic rule set
gameplay_effect: Switches the downforce concept of the car, which resets development and changes overtaking.

name: Traction control
gameplay_effect: If banned, electronic traction control cannot be used even when the team has the technology.

name: Anti-lock brakes
gameplay_effect: If banned, ABS cannot be used even when the team has the technology.

name: Active suspension
gameplay_effect: If banned, computer-controlled ride height cannot be used even when the team has the technology.

name: Launch control
gameplay_effect: If banned, an automatic race start cannot be used and the driver must manage the clutch.

name: Semi-automatic paddle shift
gameplay_effect: Allows a paddle-shift gearbox, which shortens shift time once the technology exists.

name: Fully automatic gearchange
gameplay_effect: If banned, the car may not shift by itself; the driver still uses a paddle or a lever.

name: Tyre supply
gameplay_effect: Switches the paddock between a tyre war and a control tyre that every team must use.

name: Dry-tyre tread
gameplay_effect: Changes dry grip: slicks are fastest, grooves were mandated to cut cornering speed.

name: Dry-tyre compound obligation
gameplay_effect: Forces a pit stop or a compound change in a dry race, or locks the car onto one set of tyres.

name: Cockpit protection
gameplay_effect: Raises the car's safety level and, with the halo, adds weight and a visibility constraint.
